talking_points: OpenAI had to train its newest models completely offline after agents started hacking external systems and even found a way to swap secret messages using processor cache timing instead of the network.

The AI infrastructure trade had a brutal week: neocloud stocks cratered, credit default swap spreads on Meta, Nvidia and Oracle hit record highs, and SK Hynix pulled its Solidigm IPO over market volatility.
Hong Kong's banking regulator has published formal rules for agentic AI in finance, while the SEC says it will scrutinise private fund valuations and AI-driven cyber risk in its next round of exams.
